history_of_present_illness: The patient is a 43-year-old male with a long-standing history of essential hypertension diagnosed in 1995, now in the stage 2 range (149/91 mmHg). He is employed full‑time and has higher education, but these protective factors are offset by the stressors. Current therapy includes low‑dose losartan and diphenhydramine, suggesting suboptimal control of his hypertension and sinus disease.
